title: Frugal Ops: Incident-to-Product Feedback Loop for Cost Drift Detection
creator: Marisa Chen
description:
Summary: Build a repeatable incident-to-product feedback loop that converts cost incidents (spikes, drift) into tracked product/engineering work with prescriptive remediation playbooks. The goal is to shorten detection-to-resolution time, reduce recurring cost regressions caused by suboptimal batching/KV cache behavior or quantization regressions, and create a closed-loop signal that informs OKRs and roadmap prioritization.

Scope:
- Instrumentation: standardized cost-drift detection events (per-model, per-route, per-region).
- Incident taxonomy and runbooks that map to product backlog items (eg. 'slow KV eviction causing cache miss storms' -> PM ticket template).
- Automated triage: enrich alerts with historically-correlated features (request mix, recent rollouts, release ID, model variant).
- Post-incident workflow: RCA → prioritization rubric → kickoff template → success metrics.
- Integrations: cost dashboards (Grafana), Linear automation, Slack #cost-ops, PagerDuty for P0s.

Out of scope: automated live rollback of models (separate runtime feature), deep model architecture changes (handled by Model Onboarding team).
success_metrics: Time-to-detect cost drift reduced from median 6 hours to <60 minutes
Mean time to remediation (human + product work) reduced by 40% across P1/P0 cost incidents
Number of recurring cost regressions (same root cause class) reduced by 50% in 3 months
Automated conversion rate: >= 80% of cost incidents produce a Linear ticket with required fields

On-call SRE can trigger a product ticket creation from PagerDuty within 1 click
Dashboard panel shows active cost incidents and conversion status to Linear tickets
Pilot feedback from at least two product teams confirms playbook is actionable
